question: For the prospectively selected highest-prior two-edge first-flux sector, does the complete action-conditioned second public record distinguish its base error from the unique maximum-prior omitted same-flux error under either fixed public action?
fork_classification: Action-covariant operator symmetry is a possible cost reduction, not a prerequisite for this direct, bounded two-error contrast. The two fixed actions are both evaluated as a matched matrix; no human ranking or pooling is needed. A general automorphism claim remains outside this contract.

hypotheses.informative: At least one fixed action gives nonzero total variation between complete second-public laws conditioned on the same full first record.
hypotheses.null: Both fixed actions give identical complete conditional second-public laws on this pair.
hypotheses.censored: Integrity or budget cap fails before all four cells; retain no information claim.

frozen_model: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 orbit, 36 IID red-X edges at p_X=1/10, p_Z=0; pre-action signal-only full-binary first flux/charge/vacuum record from J8R, then relation-free fixed public charge actions and complete action-conditioned full-binary second flux/charge/vacuum record. Private supports are generation/scoring-only and never action inputs; no noisy history or logical score.

matrix.omitted_error_rule: Within the 8191 nonbase errors in the same first-flux coset, select minimum weight (= maximum IID prior), then all lexicographic ties; gate requires the unique selected support [30,32,34,35].
matrix.cells: Two matched same-first-flux private errors crossed with both public actions; compute exact complete first likelihood and normalized complete second public law conditioned on the same all-zero-charge first record, then exact total variation per action.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact private-support/action cell; exact rational probabilities, no stochastic uncertainty.
matrix.integrity: Pin runner, source and input hashes; replay J8R base first law and first flux; verify unique max-prior omitted selection, all eligible sites, first/second commutation, signed-affine normalization, independent direct-moment check in every action cell, action-bound residual flux, nonnegative normalized full-binary second public rows, term/CPU caps and zero histories/arms/bootstraps.

acceptance: All four complete conditional second public laws and two exact paired total variations pass the integrity gates
One-pair result is not promoted to full-IID information/risk or an operator automorphism
Stop on first integrity or cap failure; no extra errors, records, actions, history, arms or bootstrap
stop_rule: Stop after the selected two-by-two matrix or first failed gate. Do not expand to more omitted errors, a symmetry search, full-channel risk, noisy JIT, size scaling or threshold.
